prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A high-altitude, wide-angle aerial shot captures a sleek, futuristic white aircraft labeled "PROTEUS" in bold blue letters along its fuselage. The plane is seen banking gracefully above a vast, rugged landscape of arid mountains and valleys, with the curvature of the earth subtly visible, emphasizing the altitude. The aircraft’s unique twin-boom design and elongated wings are prominent, with smooth, aerodynamic lines and minimal markings aside from the name and a thin, dark stripe running parallel to the body. The lighting is diffuse and natural, filtered through a layer of high, overcast clouds that cast a soft, even illumination across the scene, muting harsh shadows and lending a cool, slightly desaturated tone to the image. The color palette is dominated by the stark white of the aircraft contrasted against the earthy browns and muted greens of the terrain below, with hints of blue and gray in the distant horizon and sky. The camera angle is dynamic, positioned just above and behind the wing, creating a sense of motion and altitude, while the shallow depth of field keeps the aircraft in sharp focus against the sweeping, blurred landscape. The overall style is cinematic and documentary-like, evoking themes of exploration, innovation, and the majesty of flight.
